description: Error::Der(der::Error) (line 76) exposes the der crate's error type directly in the public API. Callers who match on Error::Der must take a dep on the der crate to use der::Error's variants, creating an implicit semver coupling. The only place Error::Der is produced is chain_walk when encode_to_slice fails — an internal encoding step callers cannot meaningfully handle. This should be replaced with an opaque Error::Internal variant or the encode path should be removed entirely. Exposing a dependency's error type in a public enum is an idiomatic Rust violation and a maintainer burden.
title: Error::Der exposes der::Error in public API with no useful match patterns
